title: Exoplanet transit search in TESS M dwarfs (v0.1.0): pipeline and candidate TIC 214311908
description:
A pipeline that searches one TESS sector of QLP light curves for transiting planets around M dwarfs within 100 pc: detrending (wotan), transit search (TLS), automated vetting, cross-match against known TOIs, CTOIs, planets and eclipsing binaries, injection-recovery calibration, and automated follow-up (multi-sector repetition, PRF fit of difference images, MCMC transit fit, TRICERATOPS false-positive probability).

Applied to sector 104, it recovers all 9 known transiting planets in the target list and yields one new planet candidate, TIC 214311908: P = 5.691498 ± 0.000007 d, epoch 2460852.2989 ± 0.0012 BJD_TDB, depth 15100 ± 800 ppm, duration 1.71 ± 0.10 h, Rp = 4.85 ± 0.42 R_Earth, FPP 0.09 ± 0.05. The candidate analysis and summary figures are in docs/ctoi/TIC214311908/ and notebooks/candidate-TIC214311908.ipynb. Not yet confirmed: high-resolution imaging and seeing-limited photometry are needed.
